integrity: Analytic proof supplied; finite deterministic checks corroborate only. No independent mathematical audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes finitely many infinite rays with positive constant ray weights and positive root weights; fixed \(0<t<1\). It does not treat general variable-weight trees, normal convergence, or uniform endpoint estimates. The full text of one relevant historical article was unavailable, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp two-scale convergence of Aluthge iterates on finite-branch weighted trees
